punchline: After two years of 18-hour days building The Huffington Post, Arianna Huffington came to on her office floor with a broken cheekbone.
thirty_sec: In April 2007 Arianna Huffington collapsed from exhaustion at home, hit her head on her desk and broke her cheekbone. She'd been working 18-hour days for two years building The Huffington Post. Doctors ran a brain MRI, a CAT scan and an echocardiogram, and found nothing but exhaustion and too little sleep. Sitting in those waiting rooms, she started asking questions. The Sleep Revolution is her case against the idea that burnout is the price of success.
